data.name: Lekki–Ikoyi Link Bridge
data.description: A cable-stayed toll bridge linking Ikoyi and Lekki, best seen at sunset when it is lit up.
visitor_tips: Pedestrians can walk the bridge early in the morning
Sunset photos are best from the Ikoyi end
data.safety_notes: Do not stop vehicles on the bridge.

data.name: Lekki Conservation Centre
data.description: A 78-hectare nature reserve with the longest canopy walkway in Africa, monkeys, crocodiles and wetland birds.
visitor_tips: Arrive before 10:00 to beat the heat
The canopy walkway costs extra and closes at 16:00
Wear trainers, the boardwalk can be slippery
data.safety_notes: Stay on the marked boardwalks. Do not feed the monkeys.

data.name: Nike Art Gallery
data.description: One of the largest art galleries in West Africa, with over 8,000 works across five floors.
visitor_tips: Entry is free, but prices for artworks are negotiable
Ask about the adire textile workshop
data.safety_notes: Keep bags closed in busy rooms.

data.name: Elegushi Beach
data.description: A private beach with music, food stalls, horse rides and a lively crowd at weekends.
visitor_tips: Busiest on Sunday afternoons
Agree prices for chairs and horse rides first
data.safety_notes: Strong currents: do not swim far from the shore.

data.name: Tarkwa Bay Beach
data.description: A sheltered beach across the harbour, popular for swimming and surfing, reached only by boat.
data.address: Tarkwa Bay, reached by boat from Tarzan Jetty
visitor_tips: Boats leave from Tarzan Jetty in Victoria Island
Bring cash for chairs and food
Head back before 17:00
data.safety_notes: Always wear a life jacket on the boat. Swim only where locals swim.

data.name: Freedom Park
data.description: A memorial and leisure park on the site of the old Broad Street colonial prison, with live music most evenings.
visitor_tips: Check the events board for live music nights
The food court is good value
data.safety_notes: Lagos Island traffic is heavy on weekdays; allow extra time.

data.name: Terra Kulture
data.description: An arts centre with a theatre, gallery, bookshop and Nigerian restaurant.
visitor_tips: Book theatre tickets in advance
Try the restaurant for lunch

data.name: Kalakuta Republic Museum
data.description: The former home of Afrobeat pioneer Fela Kuti, now a museum with his clothes, instruments and a rooftop bar.
visitor_tips: Combine with an evening at the New Afrika Shrine

data.title: Lekki Conservation Centre
data.description: Walk the longest canopy walkway in Africa, spot mona monkeys and crocodiles, and learn how the reserve protects Lagos wetlands with a naturalist guide.
data.meeting_point: Lekki Conservation Centre main gate, Km 19 Lekki–Epe Expressway
itinerary: Meet your guide at the main gate
data.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start. 50% refund within 24 hours. No refund for no-shows.

data.title: Tarkwa Bay Boat Trip
data.description: Cross the harbour by speedboat to a sheltered beach for swimming and grilled fish, with life jackets and a beach umbrella waiting for you.
data.meeting_point: Tarzan Jetty, Maroko Road, Victoria Island
data.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start. 50% refund within 24 hours. No refund for no-shows.

data.title: Lagos Island Heritage Walk
data.description: Trace the city's story from the old colonial prison at Freedom Park to Brazilian Quarter houses, Tinubu Square and the Cathedral Church of Christ.
data.meeting_point: Freedom Park, Broad Street, Lagos Island
data.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start. 50% refund within 24 hours. No refund for no-shows.

data.title: Nike Art Gallery Visit
data.description: Explore five floors of Nigerian art, from adire textiles to contemporary painting, and meet artists in the studio if they are in.
data.meeting_point: Nike Art Gallery, 2 Elegushi Road, Lekki Phase 1
data.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start. 50% refund within 24 hours. No refund for no-shows.

data.title: Lagos Street Food Tour
data.description: Taste suya, boli, amala, puff-puff and fresh zobo at the stalls locals swear by, with a guide who explains each dish and how spicy it really is.
data.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start. 50% refund within 24 hours. No refund for no-shows.

data.title: Victoria Island Nightlife
data.description: See Lagos after dark with a host: a rooftop sunset, Afrobeats live music and a well-known club, with a vetted Cabo ride between every stop.
data.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start. 50% refund within 24 hours. No refund for no-shows.

data.meeting_point: Arrivals hall exit, by the Cabo sign at Pillar 3
